# finding from it ("the tree stops at Elisabeth, princess of Hungary"), wrote
# the finding into queue.md, and kept nothing else. The path was then gone, and
# had to be asked for a second time. A prose summary cannot be re-checked
# against a later merge; this file can.
# LIMIT: NAMES ONLY, NO GENI IDS. The paste is the link *text* of the panel, so
# the profile IDs behind those links did not come with it. This repo's primary
# key is the Geni profile ID and it does not do fuzzy name matching for merging
# --- see CLAUDE.md. Matching this file against the tree is therefore ADVISORY:
# it answers "do we appear to hold this person" and can be wrong in both
# directions (a namesake matches, a differently-spelled record does not).
# Replacing these with profile IDs is the fix; the hrefs on that Geni page carry
# them.
# The relation column is Geni's own wording, describing how THIS person relates
# to the PREVIOUS row --- e.g. row 3 "his mother" means Caroline is Richard's
# mother. Transcribed as displayed, including where the genealogy looks odd.
# Columns: step, name, relation_to_previous, note
